finding.summary: Blank-skipping in `Arguments.iterate` silently changes semantics for every existing range consumer, not just SUM/AVERAGE
finding.evidence: packages/sheets/src/formula/arguments.ts `iterate` now does `if (isRange) { const cell = grid.get(ref); if (!cell || cell.v === undefined || cell.v === '') continue; }`. `iterate` is the shared argument walker for the whole function library (packages/sheets/src/formula/function*.ts — not in the changed-files list), so this changes behaviour for *bounded* ranges too, in functions the diff never considered: `COUNTBLANK(A1:A10)` can now only ever see non-blank cells (→ 0), `COUNTA`/`ROWS`/`COLUMNS`-style cardinality changes, and `AVERAGE(A1:A3)` with a blank A2 now divides by 2 instead of 3 — a behaviour change for existing user formulas that have nothing to do with unbounded ranges. Verify each consumer of `Arguments.iterate`/`ref` in packages/sheets/src/formula/.
